missing_facts: Does the tile have a rigid solid (SPC) core, a rigid expanded core, or is it a flexible vinyl tile? This decides the statistical suffix (.20 / .30 / .40).
classification.rationale: A PVC floor tile is a floor covering of plastics in tile form of heading 3918 and, being of polymers of vinyl chloride, falls in 3918.10.10 as vinyl tile. NY N341739 (in force) confirms CBP places PVC flooring in 3918.10.10, choosing the suffix by core construction (rigid solid core at .20). Because the core is not described, the default 'Other' suffix 3918.10.10.40 is the best guess.
